title: security-compliance-review-prep-1on1-sofia-patel
content:
Meeting: 1:1 prep with Aaron (security lead) - SOC2 / ISO readiness
Date: 2026-02-26 (tentative)
Goal: quick sync to align audit readiness gaps, confirm vendor evidence backlog + owners, and prioritize next sprint tasks for controls coverage.

Top priorities to surface
- Vendor risk: final list of 3rd-party vendors in-scope for SOC2 2026 (identify which need vendor risk assessments).
  - TODO: confirm if DatastoreX counts as a subprocessor (ticket JIRA-VR-12). Aaron to confirm.
  - Ask: any new contracts since Q4 2025 that added subprocessors? Slack thread #vendor-ops.
- Evidence backlog: what remains outstanding for CC6 (change management) and CC7 (incident mgmt) artifacts.
  - We have meeting minutes for change board but missing retention policy snapshot (owners: infra/product).
  - Audit wants proof of quarterly incident postmortem reviews for last 4 quarters — check SRE folder.
- ISO27001 overlap: identify where we can reuse evidence (avoid duplicate work).
  - Mapping doc: confluence.redwood.ai/iso-soc2-mapping draft exists but needs updates (Maya).

Draft agenda for 1:1
1) Quick status (2m) - my read of open items, Aaron fill-in
2) Vendor scoping (8m) - confirm in-scope vendors, escalate any vendor with missing attestation
3) Evidence gaps (8m) - CC6/CC7 + access control artifacts (who owns, ETA)
4) Audit timeline & blockers (6m) - vendor attestations needed before auditor kickoff?
5) Action review & owners (6m) - align sprint tickets and owners

Questions I want answered in the meeting (short bullets to ask Aaron)
- Which vendors require ROSA/Type II by the time the audit starts? (list of names)
- Are we comfortable with current encryption-at-rest evidence for private deployments? Any missing KMS logs?
- For incident management: do we have evidence of tabletop exercises in the last 12 months? If not, can SRE run one before auditor kickoff?
- Any regulatory pushes (customer asks) that should reprioritize ISO controls?

My preparation notes / quick links
- Evidence tracker: confluence.redwood.ai/soc2-evidence (filter: status=open) — open items: 14 (5 vendor-related)
- Vendor register: spreadsheet link in #vendor-ops slack pinned
- Change management evidence: /shared_drives/engineering/release-engineering/change-board/2025_Q4-minutes.pdf
- Incident postmortems: /shared_drives/engineering/site-reliability-engineering/postmortems/

Immediate actions I can take before 1:1 (pre-meeting work)
- Pull list of contracts signed since Oct 2025 and flag any new subprocessors (30m) — ACTION: Sofia
- Export access control list snapshots for private deployment clusters (60m) — ACTION: Maya or infra on slack
- Draft an email template for vendor attestation requests (Aaron to review)

Likely follow-ups after meeting
- Create JIRA tickets for each evidence gap with owners + due dates (Sprint 2026-03-01 start).
- Schedule a tabletop incident drill with SRE (if missing) — target by 2026-03-15.
- Coordinate with Legal to validate any contract language needed for subprocessors.

Notes / thoughts (scratchpad, unstructured)
- Auditor will probably ask for evidence of monitoring for private deployments; confirm log retention windows (we have 90 days in hosted, but private customers vary).
- Possibility: propose a minimal vendor attestation form to speed responses (one pager).
- Risk: DatastoreX has not provided SOC2 attestation — need contingency plan (config lock or replace).
- Keep list of high-risk vendors separate, mark with red/yellow/green in tracker.

Open questions / decision points to escalate
- If a critical vendor refuses attestation, do we require compensating controls or move off-route? Need decision by legal/vendor policy.
- SLA vs audit evidence mismatch: some product SLAs list retention that doesn't match infra config. Need to reconcile prior to auditor.

Post-meeting template (to send to attendees)
- Subject: SOC2/ISO follow-up — action items from 1:1 with Aaron
- Body: short summary + bullet action items with owners + due dates + link to evidence tracker.

End of notes.

Quick TODO (visible on top during meeting)
- [ ] Confirm DatastoreX subprocessor status (Aaron)
- [ ] Add evidence tickets in JIRA (Sofia)
- [ ] Draft vendor attestation template (Sofia -> Aaron review)
- [ ] Schedule tabletop drill (Maya/Aaron)
